name: Animal
use: Use for one animal in a list: the ID over a 13px context line, and on the right either its state (figure over word, weighted by level) or one line of condition tags. Designed from Farrowing room + Inspection walk, owner-approved 2026-10-11/12.
notUse: Not for navigation — use navigation; not for a record with an Edit rail — use record.

notUse: Not for a record without an act — use record

name: Scope
use: Use for choosing a work unit
notUse: Not for bulk selection — use select + door

name: Summary count
use: Use for overview counts that open a list above zero
notUse: Not for task progress cards — use the Home task card pattern

name: Done / record
use: Use for wrapped evidence and Edit
notUse: Not for event timelines — use Log

name: Tick in place
use: Use for an item ticked in place before saving (piglet day list)

name: Select + door
